Meet the owner

Fifteen years for somebody else, then her own room

Becky Rick started doing hair her senior year of high school and never stopped.

Right out of beauty school she went to work for a big-name chain salon, where she picked up years of experience and education. Eight years as a stylist, then seven more in management with the same company. Fifteen years in, she decided it was time to branch out — and opened Tangles on New Year's Day, 2005.

Tangles had a partner for the first several years. It's Becky's on her own now, with a team she's kept a long time, and a room that has never cared how old you are or how much hair you brought with you.
